title: ResumeRules
description: A person's rules for writing their resumes, the PIPELINE.md of their resume kit, as they edit it in Settings (PUT /api/resume-kit/rules). Only that file of the kit changes, and only if the kit last changed when updated_at says, so a stale screen cannot overwrite newer rules. The cap keeps the kit's one stored statement within D1's 100 KB limit.

updated_at.description: When the kit last changed as the screen knows it: the updated_at it last read or saved.
